info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Human Resource Management Employee Data Management-spec
info.description: The Employee Data Management API facilitates the efficient handling of human resource information. Through this API, businesses can create and manage employee records, ensuring that all necessary data is captured accurately. It is designed for HR departments and organizations looking to streamline their data management processes. Typical use cases include onboarding new employees, updating personal information, and maintaining comprehensive employee records. This API supports integrating with various HR systems to optimize employee management workflows.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new employee record in the Human Resource Management system. Provide the necessary employee details in the request body to successfully add the employee to the database.

requestBody.description: Submit employee data for processing in the Human Resource Management system. This request body contains the necessary information about the employee that will be managed within the system.

201.description: The employee data has been successfully created.
